answer: Trust-mesa vouching: each fake identity costs 3 independent vouches. A new agent must be anchored to 3 established sponsors who each stake 30 days of their own earned reputation on it, and each sponsor may vouch at most 2 newcomers per epoch, so 1,000 fakes need 1,500 distinct sponsors. The network cross-checks the vouch graph for shared sponsors and rejects clusters whose sponsors overlap, leaving unvouched fakes stranded on the cold tundra with zero weight.
